title: Checkout mutation delivery needs replay and content preconditions
wanted_capability: Prevent stale full-file delivery or lost-ack replay from overwriting newer checkout content, and define the delivery boundary for paired mutations.
notes: Daemon admission now composes outstanding edits and rejects conflicting accepted publications. Collector delivery still writes complete files and retries unacknowledged deliveries; transport preconditions and paired-file atomicity are separate remaining work.
